sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Internet - Marketplace FBA Store

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – Civil Law (Spanish heritage) with strong Common Law features in corporate, banking, and maritime law (Law 32 of 1927 patterned after Delaware corporate law)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Panama–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA, in force 2012)
Panama–Mexico Tax Information Exchange and DTA network (in force 2012)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 32 of 26 February 1927 (Sociedades Anónimas), as amended; Law 41 of 23 August 2007 and Law 23 of 27 April 2015 (AML/CFT framework); Law 129 of 2020 and Executive Decree 125 of 2022, as amended by Law 366 of 2023 (Beneficial Ownership Registry); Law 254 of 2021 (Resident Agent regulation); Executive Decree 363 of 2012 (banking AML)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) with UBO schedule
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Panamanian Notary Public (licensed attorney) acting with the Resident Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention effective in Panama since 12 May 1992; Apostille Division of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Legal Existence (Certificado de Personería Jurídica)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Directorate General of the Public Registry (Registro Público de Panamá)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of Bylaws and Shareholder/Board Powers of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Registry of Panama and Notary Public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization only for non-Hague counterparties (e.g., selected Middle East and Central Asian jurisdictions)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership Registry certificate (Certificado de Registro de Beneficiario Final)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public Registry of Panama, UBO Section

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced customer due diligence (EDD) on all UBOs under Law 23 of 2015 and UAF directives. Resident agents must screen against: (i) OFAC SDN List, (ii) UN Security Council consolidated list, (iii) EU consolidated restrictive measures, and (iv) Panama's national list maintained by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero (UAF). Domestic and foreign PEPs are flagged; enhanced monitoring applies for 12 months after public office exit. Amazon FBA e-commerce (ISIC 4791) is low-risk; target payment rails (Amazon Pay, Stripe, Airwallex) do not trigger a Panamanian PSP or banking license for the offshore seller.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sistema de Registro en Línea (S.R.L.) of the Directorate General of the Public Registry of Panama – www.registro-publico.gob.pa
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Spanish is the statutory legal language; all deeds and filings must be in Spanish. Commercial names may be in English or other Latin-script languages; non-Latin scripts require official transliteration into Spanish phonetic spelling. The entity suffix (S.A., Corp., Inc.) is mandatory.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No statutory extension; re-file after expiry. On rejection for duplication or prohibited terms, file a written reconsideration request (recurso de reconsideración) with the Directorate General within 5 business days, then an administrative appeal (recurso de apelación). Final judicial remedy is a demanda contencioso-administrativa before the Sala Tercera of the Supreme Court of Justice within 2 months of final administrative notification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. A physical registered address in Panama is mandatory; P.O. Box-only addresses are prohibited. Third-party virtual offices anchored to the licensed Resident Agent's premises are accepted and are the market standard for low-risk cross-border Amazon FBA sellers without a local operational footprint.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (<5% within the first 12 months). Inspections are triggered by complaint, UAF/AML flags, or random registry review of Resident Agent files; e-commerce operations with no local assets carry minimal inspection risk.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name search and availability certificate (Certificado de disponibilidad de nombre)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Published registry tariff plus agent handling; market range USD 40–75

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of Articles of Incorporation as Public Deed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial tariff schedule applied to the constituting act; market range USD 250–500

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Public Registry inscription fee for the incorporation deed
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registry fee schedule for USD 10,000 minimum issued capital; range USD 80–250
Market benchmark under Law 254 of 2021; range USD 300–700 annually

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register filing and record maintenance (Law 129 of 2020)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Registry of Panama, UBO Section / Resident Agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Agent administration fee plus official filing cost

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT KYC, PEP and sanctions screening of UBOs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial compliance pricing per ultimate beneficial owner; EDD with OFAC/UN/PEP database query

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille certification of the deed and certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama, Legalization Section
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official state fee; agency-assisted rate is higher (USD 60–100)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish-to-English translation of the deed and corporate certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate per corporate deed; typical range USD 100–200

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Directorate General of Revenue (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official processing fee and digital certificate

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Municipal registration and Aviso de Operación
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal patent schedule: USD 50 base plus 2% of capital over USD 10,000 plus e-commerce processing; aggregate market range USD 150–300

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of Panama, 'Ley General de Sociedades Anónimas'), as amended by Ley 5 de 2001; applicable sections: Arts. 1-4 (incorporation), Art. 6 (authorized capital), Art. 23 (registered office), Art. 24 (resident agent), Arts. 28-30 (directors and officers); supplementary provisions of the Código de Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección de Registro de Sociedades Mercantiles (Mercantile Section), Panama City.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Pacto Social / Escritura Constitutiva de Sociedad Anónima (Articles of Incorporation), executed as a private deed and presented for mercantile inscription.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under Ley 32 de 1927; customary authorized capital is USD 10,000 divided into 10,000 shares of USD 1.00 par value, fully subscribed but not required to be paid in. No escrow account or capital deposit obligation; a subscribed-share declaration in the shareholders ledger suffices.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION — [Company Name] S.A. The undersigned initial Board of Directors of the Company resolves as follows: 1. The subscription of the authorized share capital is ratified and shares are allotted to the founding shareholders per the Articles of Incorporation. 2. The registered office is fixed at [Registered Office Address], Panama City, Republic of Panama; the Resident Agent is confirmed. 3. The President, Secretary, and Treasurer are appointed for the first fiscal year; the President and Secretary are jointly authorized to sign. 4. Corporate bank accounts may be opened; wire transfers, checks, and FBA payout instructions require the joint signatures so fixed. Approved unanimously and effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sede Electrónica (Online Merchant Services Portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the 'Solicitud de Búsqueda de Nombre' online with the Public Registry; pay the search tariff of approximately USD 30; obtain the 'Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre' evidencing that the proposed corporate name is available and reserved. The certificate is valid for 30 business days and must be delivered to the incorporation attorney for attachment to the Pacto Social.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of passport or national ID of each subscribing shareholder
Proposed corporate name with at least three alternative names
Power of attorney appointing the resident agent or Panamanian law firm (apostilled if executed abroad)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing registration, the Registry issues a reclassification note; the attorney immediately re-files an alternative name search. A 'recurso de reconsideración' may be lodged with the Dirección General del Registro within 5 business days contesting any erroneous refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Articles of Incorporation (Pacto Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Panamanian attorney (Abogado) and, if used, a Notary Public; Ley 32 de 1927 permits private-deed execution without mandatory notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporation attorney drafts the Pacto Social including the corporate name, general e-commerce marketplace object (ISIC 4791), authorized capital structure, initial board of directors, officers, registered office address, and the mandatory resident agent clause. The founding shareholders or their attorneys execute the deed; any issuance of share certificates and assignment of stamp duty are documented. The executed document must be in Spanish or accompanied by a certified Spanish version.
required_dossiers: Valid name search certificate
Shareholder identification and beneficial ownership declaration (Ley 49 de 2016)
Resident agent acceptance letter and registered office address confirmation
Draft by-laws or statutory powers rider, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material drafting errors are cured by executing an 'Acuerdo de Corrección' or rectification deed before filing; immaterial typographical errors are remedied informally by the Registry's correction channel without new execution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registration (Inscripción) with the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Dirección de Registro de Sociedades Mercantiles (filing desk or online submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Pacto Social together with the name certificate and the payment receipt for the registration tariff (approximately USD 250-300, based on authorized capital and page count). The Registrar examines legal form and compliance; upon approval, an inscription order records the company in the Mercantile Register and assigns the corporate folio number.
required_dossiers: Executed Pacto Social (original)
Valid name search certificate
Registry tariff payment receipt
Resident agent acceptance letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an objection ('razón' or defect notice), the attorney must respond or amend the Pacto Social within the granted term (usually 10-30 days). Failure to cure leads to archiving; re-presentation is permitted without a new name search while the certificate remains valid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Inscription Legalization: Registration Certificate and Statutory Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Certificates and Certified Copies Office; corporate administration agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Request the 'Certificado de Registro' and a certified copy of the inscribed Pacto Social. Open the Shareholders Ledger (Registro de Acciones) and the Board Resolutions Minutes Book (Libro de Actas), both stamped by the Public Registry; issue physical or digital share certificates; affix the corporate seal and adopt the registered corporate address for service of process.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration
Certified copy of the inscription order
Officer and director list
Corporate book stamping application and registry fee receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Lost or illegible certificates are replaced by obtaining 'certificados de concordancia' or 'copia autorizada' from the Registry archives; discrepancies in the inscription are corrected by a 'reforma' filing before the Mercantile Section.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registry (RUC) and Annual Franchise Tax Notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — online e-Tax portal; Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. in the RUC system and obtain the taxpayer identification number. Enroll for the annual flat franchise tax (USD 300 payable quarterly). For a purely offshore Amazon FBA operation with no Panamanian-sourced income, file the annual sworn declaration ('Declaración Jurada Anual') showing zero territorial income and remit only the franchise fee. Municipal business licensing is required only if a physical Panama City office is opened; the remote FBA model is excluded.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration
Certified copy of the inscribed Pacto Social
Power of attorney appointing the fiscal representative
Passport copies of directors and shareholders
Amazon FBA seller dashboard evidence of extraterritorial sales (supporting the zero territorial income position)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DGI issues a 'requerimiento' for additional documentation, the fiscal representative must respond within the statutory term (typically 5 business days). Late RUC registration is cured by an 'inscripción extemporánea' filing with the applicable surcharge; penalties may be waived upon voluntary disclosure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no Panamanian industrial license is prescribed for ISIC 4791 retail-sale-via-internet FBA marketplace activity. Should a physical distribution warehouse be established on Panamanian territory, the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (Dirección Nacional de Empresas y Comercio) would govern the commercial operating notice, not a manufacturing license.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for the offshore e-commerce operation; the municipal 'Aviso de Operación' (Comercio/Industria license) of the Municipio de Panamá would be triggered only if a local office or warehouse is opened.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: MiAMBIENTE — Ministerio de Ambiente, Dirección de Evaluación de Impacto Ambiental (formerly ANAM)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the FBA marketplace model constitutes a purely digital trading activity with no physical works, construction, or installed industrial capacity; no EIA Study, EsIA registration, or prior consultation is required under Decreto Ejecutivo 123 de 2007. Categorization would apply only upon installation of a Panamanian fulfilment warehouse (Category II or III).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — no wastewater discharge, VOC emissions, or solid-waste generation points arise from the e-commerce trading activity. If a Panamanian warehouse is later added, compliance thresholds are the wastewater discharge criteria of MiAMBIENTE Resolución AG-0287-2010, general air-quality regulations under Ley 41 de 1998, and national solid-waste management rules under the environmental framework law; packaging waste from returned goods would be governed by the applicable waste-transport manifests.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable without physical premises. If a Panama office or warehouse is opened, the Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá issues the 'Visto Bueno de Bomberos' (fire-safety clearance); the municipal engineering department performs structural load inspection; and the Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral (MITRADEL) requires employer registration and occupational accident insurance coverage (RIESA) under the applicable occupational safety regulations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Republic of Panama; e-services portal: Sede Electrónica de la DGI (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa). Export and customs evidence is handled by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas de Panamá (ANA) through the Sistema de Gestión Aduanera (SGA) and the Ventanilla Única de Comercio Exterior (VUCEA).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) must obtain a RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) before commencing taxable operations. The standard procedure is: (1) appoint a Panamanian registered agent and maintain a licensed law-firm address; (2) obtain a Panamanian digital signature (Firma Digital) issued by the Autoridad Nacional para la Innovación Gubernamental (AIG); (3) file the Aviso de Operación and RUC application with the DGI through Sede Electrónica; (4) obtain the municipal business license in the relevant district if a local establishment is maintained; (5) register with the Caja de Seguro Social (CSS) if local employees are hired; and (6) open a Panamanian bank account for tax settlement. For a pure cross-border Amazon FBA exporter with no local retail establishment, the RUC is nevertheless used for territorial income-tax filing, ITBMS compliance, and any export-refund claim.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope (entity-level taxation applies only to Panama-source income; the S.A. is not a pass-through entity and is not classified as a Tax_Exempt_Zone entity under the general corporate regime)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. Panama has no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch entity classification election. The S.A. is automatically a separate taxable legal person. Qualifying small taxpayers may elect the simplified MIPYME tax regime under applicable Panamanian law; special elective regimes exist for SEM/Multinational Headquarters but do not apply to general Amazon FBA operations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — Panama's VAT/GST-equivalent system, extended to digital services supplied from abroad.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No turnover threshold. Registration is mandatory before making taxable transfers of goods or services in Panama or before supplying digital services to Panamanian recipients. A non-resident digital service provider must register and charge 7% ITBMS on applicable digital sales. An exporter whose Amazon FBA sales are exclusively to foreign end customers may have no local ITBMS collection obligation, but RUC registration is still required for income-tax territorial determinations and to substantiate zero-rating.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Panama mandates electronic invoicing for taxpayers registered with the DGI, through DGI-authorized electronic invoicing operators or the DGI Factura Electrónica channel. The electronic invoice must comply with the DGI XML format, contain the taxpayer's RUC, and include an approved invoice number/authorization. For exports, the invoice must identify the zero-rated nature of the transaction and be supported by customs export records. Large taxpayers and digital-service providers are subject to periodic electronic filing and DGI data-matching; while not every transaction is cleared in real time, DGI may require transmission and validation of invoices before or shortly after issuance for specified taxpayer segments.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods are subject to 0% ITBMS where the goods are physically removed from Panamanian territory, title transfers to a non-resident buyer, and the export is evidenced by customs and transport documents. Offshore services supplied for use/consumption abroad, including e-commerce platform services and fulfillment services performed outside Panama, are also zero-rated if not economically connected to Panama. Amazon FBA cross-border sales will qualify only where the final customer is outside Panama and the goods are not sold or delivered within Panamanian territory. The exporter must maintain a documented file demonstrating the foreign destination and actual receipt of funds from the marketplace.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación) accepted by the Autoridad Nacional de Aduanas (ANA)
Bill of Lading, Airway Bill, or courier receipt showing shipment from Panama to a foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank statement evidencing receipt of the Amazon FBA settlement from outside Panama
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the customs declaration
Amazon central seller statement or settlement report identifying the country of the end customer
Customs broker invoice and ANA export-register entry
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI may deny zero-rating, reclassify the sale as taxable, and assess 7% ITBMS plus surcharges and interest if the export documentation is incomplete or inconsistent. Penalties range up to 100% of the omitted tax, with additional fines and criminal liability for fraudulent export declarations or forged customs documents. The statute of limitations is generally five years, but the period is extended in cases of fraud. If funds are retained abroad beyond 180 days without credible banking evidence and the territorial-source test is not satisfied, the DGI may treat the receipts as Panama-source and assess income tax, corporate taxes, and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as the apex banking, foreign-exchange compliance, and AML/CFT supervisor; the Republic of Panama does not operate a monetary-issuing central bank. Banco Nacional de Panamá (BNP) performs only limited fiscal-agency functions for the State.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full de facto dollarization. The Panamanian Balboa (PAB) is a nominal unit pegged 1:1 to the United States dollar, and U.S. dollar bills and coins circulate as legal tender. There are no exchange-control laws, no conversion permits, and both current-account and capital-account transactions are freely convertible and transferable. Cross-border profit remittance requires no FX authorization; however, dividends paid from Panamanian-source income are subject to a 5% or 10% withholding tax depending on the corporate regime and distributed-reserve status. Foreign-source income of a Panamanian corporation remains outside Panama's territorial income tax base, so Amazon marketplace income sourced abroad is generally not taxed by Panama, but banking source-of-funds evidence is still required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama imposes no statutory surrender, repatriation, or mandatory conversion requirement on export receipts or marketplace sales proceeds. The Amazon FBA seller may freely maintain foreign-currency balances abroad or clear them into a licensed Panamanian USD account without reporting to the SBP; only AML/CFT and tax-information duties apply.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational US-Dollar Current Account (Cuenta Corriente) with online treasury and SWIFT capabilities
Operational US-Dollar Current Account and foreign-trade settlement account with correspondent banking network
Operational US-Dollar Current Account with integrated ACH and electronic-payments platform
Operational US-Dollar Current Account and commercial settlement line for marketplace receivables
Operational US-Dollar Current Account and international private-banking relationship
Operational US-Dollar Current Account with treasury sweep, ACH, and SWIFT cross-border rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium. Panama does not recognize a dedicated 'electronic money institution' charter, though Law 1 of 2024 created a fintech and virtual-asset licensing regime under the SBP. Digital-only offshore EMIs such as Airwallex, Payoneer, and Stripe cannot issue local PAN-denominated IBANs; they can, however, settle funds into a Panamanian USD account via U.S. correspondent banks. For treasury purposes, a licensed SBP-supervised bank remains the mandatory primary clearing account, and any prolonged use of an unlicensed EMI as the sole collection account will trigger elevated AML scrutiny from Panamanian banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: SBP AML regulations permit remote corporate onboarding for low-risk entities using apostilled or legalized documentation, but Tier-1 Panamanian banks generally require a live videoconference KYC interview with the legal representative and frequently a physical branch appointment for the signatory or a notarized power of attorney duly apostilled in the country of signature. The complete abolition of bearer shares under Law 23 of 2015 requires identification of every ultimate beneficial owner before account opening, and the bank will verify the corporate registration and UBO filing in the Registro Público de Panamá.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete or contradictory disclosure of ultimate beneficial ownership; any indication of historically bearer-share to registered-share conversion or nominee shareholder structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified articles of incorporation and bylaws; certificate of corporate existence issued by the Registro Público; UBO registry filing certificate; director resolution listing natural-person beneficiaries; certified share register maintained by the resident agent; passports and tax identification numbers of all beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Marketplace proceeds arriving from Amazon or Amazon-related PSP entities without clear commercial relationship and source-of-funds trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Amazon Marketplace Seller Agreement; Amazon seller dashboard and payout statements; order-level settlement reports; bank statements from the funding marketplaces; commercial invoices issued by the S.A.; registered-agent certificate confirming commercial activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Concentration of treasury flows through unlicensed offshore EMIs or payment aggregators instead of an SBP-licensed bank.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Regulatory analysis explaining the use of the EMI; licensing or authorization certificate of the EMI in its home jurisdiction; complete transaction log mapping EMI flows to the Panamanian corporate account; board resolution approving the transition to a licensed SBP bank as the primary settlement rail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions-list, PEP, or adverse-media name hits on the shareholder base or on the corporate name during negative-news screening.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid passport or national ID of the matched person; apostilled police-record certificate from country of residence; written PEP/name-match rationalization letter; sworn statement of economic substance; reference letter from a bank in the country of residence of the principal shareholder.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions are routed by SWIFT MT103/MT202 from the shareholder's foreign bank directly to the S.A.'s licensed Panamanian bank account, with field 70 (Remittance Information) stating 'Capital Contribution' or 'Shareholder Investment' and, where possible, the purpose code for foreign direct investment in Panama. No central-bank approval or prior exchange license is required. The bringing bank will require the source-of-funds package: share capital resolution, latest share register, certified articles, UBO declaration, and the debit confirmation from the remitting institution.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: International trade settlements are completed through SWIFT MT103/MT202 via the Panamanian bank's correspondent network (typically Bank of America, Citi, or HSBC in the United States), and commercial import/export transactions may be supported by irrevocable documentary letters of credit issued under UCP 600. For Amazon vendor and fulfillment payments, funds are cleared via ACH through U.S. correspondent accounts; European EUR disbursements are cleared through SEPA; domestic Panamanian transfers use the local ACH clearing house (Cámara de Compensación Automatizada) and the newer SBP instant-payment system (SPI Panama).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable forwards in USD/EUR, USD/GBP, USD/MXN, and other liquid pairs offered by SBP-licensed commercial banks
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing Latin American currencies, executed through the bank's international trading desk without the need for local onshore delivery
Cross-currency swaps (USD versus EUR, GBP, or MXN) for balance-sheet hedging of long-term marketplace receivables
Overnight and tom-next FX swaps used for liquidity gap management between Amazon inbound settlement dates and trade-payable due dates

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Return and Payment (Tasa Única Anual)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) / Registro Público de Panamá (through a licensed bank or registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each year, covering the preceding calendar year (1 January – 31 December).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues an automatic 10% penalty plus interest at the official banking rate; failure to pay for three consecutive fiscal years permits the Registro Público to administratively dissolve or strike off the S.A.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Shareholders' Declaration (Declaración Anual de Accionistas)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Mercantile Section
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed annually during March (by 31 March), reflecting shareholdings as of 31 December of the prior year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Filing outside the deadline triggers fines of up to USD 100 and a temporary suspension of the corporation's Good Standing (Paz y Salvo); continued non-compliance may block registration of share transfers and issuance of certified documents.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) / no-taxable-event declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) – Panama Tax Authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the close of the fiscal year, i.e., no later than 31 March; a no-taxable (sin hecho imponible) declaration is required even where all sales are foreign-sourced.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file creates fines from USD 20 to USD 10,000 plus a monthly surcharge of 5% of the tax due (capped at 50%); prolonged default invites administrative seizure/embargo and denial of clearance certificates until the return is presented.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Panamanian S.A. must appoint an independent public accountant as fiscal auditor (Revisor Fiscal) when it is publicly traded, licensed as a bank/insurance/reinsurance entity, or has annual gross revenue exceeding USD 3,000,000 or total assets exceeding USD 5,000,000. A private cross-border e-commerce company below those thresholds may lawfully prepare and file unaudited financial statements unless a group or creditor contract imposes an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panama has adopted International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as the primary accounting framework for reporting entities; private non-public S.A.s may maintain books under Panamanian GAAP (PCGA) when their operations are limited in scale, provided that the accounting base is applied consistently and the books are kept in Spanish or with a sworn Spanish translation.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A. is required to maintain a current Register of Shareholders and a Beneficial Ownership Register at its registered agent's office in Panama. Any transfer of shares must be entered in the Corporate Share Transfer Ledger and, for full legal effect, endorsed in the share certificate and recorded with the Registro Público. Annually, by 31 March, the registered agent prepares and submits the Declaración Anual de Accionistas covering the beneficiaries and shareholders as of 31 December. The declaration is mandatory even if no changes occurred during the year; a transfer made mid-year must be disclosed in the next annual declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Share Transfer Ledger (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Beneficial Ownership Register (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300 – USD 1,500 per year (standard Panama registered agent and registered office service; the upper band includes mail handling, annual declaration filing, and tax compliance support).
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,200 – USD 5,000 for a certified audit of a small e-commerce S.A.; a lower-cost review or compilation may range from USD 600 – USD 1,200.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta, ISR) for FY2019 onward, replacing the former 12.5% band on the first USD 1.5 million of taxable income.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: 0% tax on sales proceeds from foreign-source e-commerce activity (Amazon FBA deliveries to customers located outside Panama); 0% under the SEM (Multinational Headquarters) regime for qualifying headquarters services; Colon Free Zone relief for goods introduced/declared inside the CFZ; no statutory tax holiday for ordinary FBA retail; 5-year loss carryforward available only against Panamanian-source taxable income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 105 (Declaración de Renta de Personas Jurídicas) filed via the DGI's T@X electronic portal (https://dgi.mef.gob.pa); payments are settled through Banco Nacional and the DGI virtual Treasury.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the close of the fiscal year; calendar-year S.A. must file and pay on or before March 31 of the following fiscal year. A non-calendar fiscal year-end (approved by the DGI) shifts the deadline to the third month after that fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: RUC, DV, corporate name, activity code (ISIC 4791 / NAICS 454110), domicile, fiscal year, board representative.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Panamanian S.A.'s RUC; non-resident shareholders/directors are not listed; a resident agent (agente residente) must be identified if the board resides abroad.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 — Ingresos brutos de fuente extranjera
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from commercial operations performed outside Panamanian territory, including sales completed by Amazon Fulfillment facilities abroad.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all Amazon seller proceeds sourced from non-Panamanian customers; this exclusion is the core territorial claim and must be substantiated with geo-transaction reports, marketplace settlement statements, banking records from Airwallex/Stripe/Amazon Pay, and fulfilment-facility proof.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 — Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from sales, commissions, or services where the occupational activity, contracting, or delivery occurred within Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any Amazon FBA sales are delivered to Panamanian customers, those amounts are taxable; the S.A. should maintain Pay-order/VAT-withholding records for such domestic sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: COGS allocable to Panamanian-source revenue only; foreign-source COGS is excluded because foreign-source gross profit is excluded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate COGS pro-rata using gross-receipts ratio; document the allocation methodology on the workpaper attached to the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses deductible against Panamanian-source income: platform fees, advertising, shipping, customs, professional fees, administrative overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident e-commerce sellers may deduct only expenses apportioned to Panama; expenses invoiced to the S.A. by the foreign supplier must be at arm's length and free of intra-group margins where TP thresholds apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-loss carryforward from prior years (maximum 5 years) applied against current Panamanian-source taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses generated by foreign-source activity are not claimable; only losses arising from Panamanian-source operations may be carried forward.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net Panamanian-source taxable income after losses and all deductions; the basis for the 25% ISR.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If all FBA income is foreign-source, this box is zero; the return still must be filed with the foreign-source income fully disclosed in Box 2.
N/A when Box 7 is zero; any tax withheld at source by Panamanian customers must be credited.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for advance payments (anticipos), DGI withholdings, single-tax payments, and SEM/CFZ credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The company must upload the T@X advance-payment receipts and any withholding certificates from Panamanian customers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 10 — Saldo a pagar / a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net payment due or refund credit; payment must be executed through the virtual Treasury on or before the filing deadline.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a refund credit is claimed for ITBMS or dividend tax over-withheld, attach the supporting invoices and present refund via Form 1104 within 3 years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of USD 100 to USD 500 fixed by the DGI plus a monthly surcharge of 1% on the unpaid tax (maximum 10%); default interest accrues at 10% per annum; non-filing after administrative demand triggers estimated assessment, bank-data subpoena, and risk of criminal tax fraud charge; a totally unfiled return can also block issuance of the 'Paz y Salvo' tax certificate required for bank transfers and public registrations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 1221 — Anexo de Operaciones con Sujetos Relacionados (transfer pricing annex) plus Formulario 1222 — Estudio de Precios de Transferencia, both submitted through the DGI T@X portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed simultaneously with Formulario 105, i.e., within three months after fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year taxpayers). The underlying contemporaneous TP documentation must be prepared no later than the return due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A — Identificación de la entidad y del grupo
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: RUC, group ultimate parent, country of residence, global structure chart, CbC reporting status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the Amazon group entities, the foreign seller Entity, and any Panamanian holding/parent; Amazon.com, Inc., Amazon EU S.à r.l., Amazon Services LLC should be listed where contractual relationships exist.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Operaciones con partes relacionadas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Listing of controlled transactions: purchases of goods, platform fees, logistics reimbursements, loans, royalty/software payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a general FBA merchant, disclose payments to Amazon (fees, FBA charges, advertising) only if Amazon is a related party; if the S.A. trades with third-party marketplaces at arm's length, the annex is usually nil-filed but still mandatory when the transaction threshold is exceeded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Selection of the most appropriate method (CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split) and the arm's length range.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: TNMM is the customary method for e-commerce distribution/sales activities; use the Berry-ratio variant where the S.A. performs routine selling functions; ensure comparability adjustments.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Disclosure of any transactions with tax-haven jurisdictions (per Panama Resolution 201-0718) and any deemed 'defectively transparent' entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the shareholder is a Delaware LLC, BVI, or Cayman entity, the DGI scrutinizes the transaction and may disallow deductions; exculpatory evidence of business purpose must be attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section E — Ajustes de precios de transferencia
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-adjustments: corrections to income or expense to ensure the final taxable result is arm's length.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Voluntary adjustments are reported here and included in the ISR base; no adjustment is required where all results are foreign-source and thus outside Panama's territorial scope.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Financial ratios used in the comparability analysis (operating margin, return on assets, Berry ratio).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: N/A for foreign-source-only filers, but must be prepared if the Panama return has positive domestic net income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or false filing of Form 1221/1222: surcharge of 5% of the value of the related-party transaction (per Law 45 of 2013 enforcement rules), fines from USD 1,000 to USD 50,000, and adjustment of taxable income under DGI's substituted determination (base presunta); interest at 10% per annum runs from the underpayment date; the directors who signed false annexes become jointly liable for the adjustment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on dividends paid from profits that were subject to the Panamanian corporate income tax; 20% final withholding tax on dividends distributed from profits that were not subject to ISR (e.g., foreign-source FBA profits or tax-exempt profits) unless the corporation has paid the complementary 10% corporate tax to 'thicken' the profits; both rates apply irrespective of the shareholder's residence. No Panama currency controls restrict outgoing USD dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Panama's DTAs in force (Mexico, South Korea, Singapore, UAE, UK, Ireland, France, Netherlands, Portugal, Qatar, Spain, Barbados, Cuba) may reduce the dividend WHT (generally to 5%-10%). Procedure: the beneficial-owner shareholder must (i) obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its own revenue authority authenticated by apostille or consular legalization, (ii) complete the DGI treaty-relief application/payment-voucher annotation, (iii) submit the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the Panamanian withholding agent before the dividend payment date, and (iv) retain the records for a five-year statute of limitations. If the TRC is not obtained in time, the statutory 10%/20% is withheld and the shareholder must claim a refund through a formal DGI proceeding; no DTA exists with the United States, so US shareholders rely on domestic rates.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest: no Panama withholding tax applies to interest paid to non-resident lenders when the loan is entered into abroad and the funds are deployed outside Panama, and no WHT is imposed generally on foreign financing; treaty rates for protected interest are typically 5%-10% in negotiated DTAs. Royalties and technical fees for IP/licences exploited in Panama: final 12.5% WHT on the gross payment (reduced to 5%-10% under relevant DTAs) plus 7% ITBMS transfer for taxable services where applicable; payments for IP rights utilized exclusively abroad are treated as foreign-source and are not subject to Panama WHT.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Reporting threshold in Panamanian balboas (B/. pegged 1:1 with USD): a contemporaneous TP study and Form 1221/1222 are required when (i) annual gross income exceeds B/. 15,000,000, or (ii) the aggregate value of transactions with related parties in the fiscal year exceeds B/. 5,000,000; a Master File/CbC report is required for multinational groups with consolidated annual revenue of EUR/USD 750,000,000 or more. Below these thresholds, the taxpayer must still be able to demonstrate arm's length pricing on request.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Law 254 of 2021 (Panama Economic Substance Regulations) requires locally registered entities carrying out 'relevant activities' to maintain substantive presence in Panama. An Amazon FBA S.A. managing a distribution/service-centre function, or holding IP and receiving related income, is a relevant entity. There is no specified economic substance requirement for a purely passive non-Panamanian FBA flow, but the S.A. that claims 100% foreign-source income must prove that the trading, procurement, fulfillment, and contracting functions are executed abroad; a shell S.A. with nominee directors, no local employees, no records and no physical office will be treated as conducting its business in Panama, making the profit taxable at 25% and exposing the entity to ESR penalties for failure to file the substance return with the DGI.
